title: Kashmir youth abandoned separatist sentiment: Amit Shah

ai.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that after the 2019 abrogation of Article 370, no Kashmiri youth are involved in terrorism, ending 35 years of violence and separatist sentiment in the Kashmir Valley.

facts.claim: after the 2019 abrogation of Article 370, no Kashmiri youth are involved in terrorism
facts.quote: After over 35 years of violence, not a single local youth of Kashmir Valley is now involved in terrorism,

facts.claim: the abrogation of Article 370 ended separatist sentiments among Kashmiri youth
facts.quote: the abrogation of Article 370 has brought an end to the sense of separatism among the youth of Kashmir

facts.claim: the change in Kashmir was brought about not merely by eliminating terrorists but also by ending the atmosphere of discrimination and alienation among the youth of Kashmir
facts.quote: the change in Kashmir was brought about not merely by eliminating terrorists but also by ending the atmosphere of discrimination and alienation among the youth of Kashmir

ai.background_note: The J&K statehood movement has been protesting since 2026 over the Centre's failure to restore J&K's statehood after it was split into two union territories in 2019.
